acceptanceCriteria: the live dirty-worktree selection test passes deterministically with a 14-path dirty set under load ~30, or its bound is restated with the dirty-set size it holds for
a test proves the stated bound bites
body: Residual from the V1-1351 gate-tooling lane (PR #943). internal/liveverify/affected TestSelectionOnTheLiveDirtyWorktree. Expected: selection within its 6.67 ratio bound. Actual: ratio 10-14 with a 14-path dirty worktree; at BASE 883caa3d2 with the same 10 modified paths dirty the ratio was 7.33 (fail) and 6.39 (pass); passes on a clean tree. Loads ~30. Reproduce: dirty about 10 tracked paths, then GOTOOLCHAIN=local go test -count=1 -run TestSelectionOnTheLiveDirtyWorktree ./internal/liveverify/affected under load around 30. Suspected: the bound scales poorly with dirty-set size; not a regression from PR #943.

title: TestSelectionOnTheLiveDirtyWorktree exceeds its 6.67 ratio bound with ~10+ dirty paths under load
